documents.title: Montgomery County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 191 pages. Amounts are the 2026 column ('2026 APPROPRIATION' on the budget summary pp. 3-4; '2026' column of each department form). 2025 column ignored. column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
